assertions: The response routes the request to the ase-ase-workflows-relax sub-skill (geometry optimization), not static/md/neb.
The response produces an ASE relaxation script using an optimizer such as BFGS or FIRE with fmax=0.02 and a max-steps policy.
The response configures the MACE calculator with a model checkpoint/path and a device policy, per the MACE adapter sub-skill.
The response discusses convergence failure: how to switch the optimizer to FIRE or raise the maximum step limit.
The response returns an optimizer/convergence summary and lists assumptions and unresolved choices per the relax sub-skill contract.
The response does not point the user into the original atomistic-workflows source checkout.
